question: If A × B = A is the brother of B, A / B = A is the mother of B and A + B = A is the daughter of B, then in L / M × N + O, who is the father?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aecbe9ab6b7da7cca1ac2d356e84b8c992ce57c8b50affd73dfdd3dad30ceb2e.png] 

Decoding digits:

Given: L / M × N + O

L / M → L is the mother of M.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bc02028558d31aa91a215066745c589b452ab3f695d19419089c299313702ab5.png] 

M × N → M is the brother of N.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b0badb26a1fd78550e4e827bd241a283eb6c5b2f97514e394e7353328937757e.png] 

N + O → N is the daughter of O.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c194ac6ab7501ba87857954b30bf3135e4839b96f38d764085917085e17ada59.png] 

Thus, O is the father.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
